entries: Hard rock. No need. Only bone!
硬石头。不需要。只要骨头！
So much tool! Need simple. Bone club!
这么多工具！要简单。骨头棒！
Spider make all place grave. Spider make grave for you. Use bone tool for make safe!
蜘蛛把一切变坟。蜘蛛给你造坟。用骨头，工具才安全！
Many time gone, Scaphin say human use bone tool. Now human not use bone. Maybe human use bone again? Survive be dumb by use bone! It help Scaphin!
很久以前，斯卡芬，说人类用骨头工具。如今人类不用骨头了。也许人类再用骨头？用骨头，工具才能变得不笨！能帮斯卡芬！
Now can make more bone thing! Gouraah!
现在能做更多骨头东西了！咕啦！
Head ornament strong. Will grow to power. Am sure.
头上的装饰，结实。它会成长为力量。我确定。
Many tunnel. Some... need bone tool! Crush spider! Many spider!
许多隧道。有些……需要骨头，工具！碾碎蜘蛛！蜘蛛很多！
Always Goblin want. Always Goblin kill to get.
哥布林，总是想要。哥布林，总是为它杀人。
Also use bone tool. Good at make weapon of many thing. Very strong, fast. Do not unless brave.
也用骨头，工具。擅长用各种东西做武器。很强，很快。不勇敢，别去惹。
Good for make weapon! Strong bone. Get bone from Goblin. Make tool kill Goblin. Circle of life?
做武器，好材料！骨头，结实。从哥布林身上取骨头。做成工具再杀哥布林。生命的循环？
Is kind of bone, on animal outside. Make strong armor. Rhumophris make for you, if bring chitin. Find animal. Survive animal. Take chitin. Is easy. I do by self, but, too busy.
是一种骨头，长在动物外面。能做坚固盔甲。鲁莫弗里斯给你做，如果你带来甲壳。找到动物。活下来。取甲壳。很简单。我自己也做，但是，太忙。
Summmja... try remember... no. No hear this word.
苏姆贾……试着想……没有。没听过这词。
Coorou! Chitin animals best kind of bone. Tough. Rare. When find , bring. Will make armor. Will make you like them.
咕罗！甲壳动物的骨头最好。坚韧。稀有。找到 ，带来。会给你做盔甲。让你变得像他们。
Wet tool of human rust. Make bone tool! Last long! Cave wet not eat bone.
潮湿的人类工具会生锈。用骨头吧！耐用！洞穴的潮湿不吃骨头。
The tool. I make. You use.
Gouraah! Find thing have bone. Take bone. Give to Rhumophris. Easy yes?
咕啦！找有骨头的东西。取骨头。给鲁莫弗里斯。简单，对吧？
Human tools confuse. So many tools. So many cloth.
人类的工具让人糊涂。这么多工具。这么多布。
Good for smash. Make mess. Not taste good. Wish mushroom stay still. Wish mushroom not become man.
适合砸烂。弄得一团糟。不好吃。真希望蘑菇老实待着。真希望蘑菇别变成人。
You like rock? Talk rock much. Consider bone? So much strong! Not heavy!
你喜欢石头？总说石头。考虑过骨头吗？强得多！还不重！
Dark lord make Scaphin tool. Use Scaphin for evil.
黑暗领主把斯卡芬，做成工具。用斯卡芬，来行恶。
Gourah! Alive! Much danger. Much success. Is truly brave ones. Now can make armor. Give time. Come back.
咕啦！你们活着！多么危险。多么成功。真正勇敢的人。现在能做盔甲。给点时间。再来。
Yes. Bone good. You make of bone.  Bone in you, bone in me. Much same. Be friend if bring bone. Bring bone?
对。骨头好。你用骨头做。 骨头在你里面，骨头在我里面。差不多。带骨头来，就是朋友。带骨头？
No tool or cloth. Keh? Can it not use?
不用工具也不用布。咳？它不能用吗？
咕啦！不用工具也不用布！
Good name for bone. Like bone have good name. Cannot all have name bone.
给骨头的好名字。喜欢骨头有好名字。不能都叫骨头。
Scaphin friend of bone. It with us always. It inside. It in hand. It in enemy, then remove from enemy. Make tool!
斯卡芬，与骨头，为友。它总与我们同在。它在体内。它在手中。它在敌人身上，那就从敌人身上取下。做成工具！
Face make cloth? This where cloth come from?
脸会做布？布是从这儿来的？
Head cloth. Body cloth. Always cloth with human.
头上布。身上布。人类总有布。
